scope: 55 records: independent structural and readiness inspection plus external spot-check of original NIH ODS exercise performance and EFSA vitamin B6 source

findings.detail: All 55 source_passage_audit entries explicitly say claim_by_claim_full_audit=false. Source URL plus dose note is not validation of indication, safety, interactions and translations.
All 55 release_gate.automatic_recommendation_allowed=false; user-defined no-professional-signoff policy is compatible with keeping evidence and safety gating.
No evidence that all individual interactions, contraindications, age/pregnancy and formulation conditions are fully verified and wired to active decision rules.
Prior audit explicitly marked dose/formulation precision partial.
Many nutrient reference_intake fields are total dietary RDAs/AIs, not individualized supplemental dose.
EFSA adult UL 12 mg/day versus US FNB adult UL 100 mg/day; locale-specific dose safety cannot be inferred from RDA alone.

next_actions: Map each indication, dosage, contraindication and interaction to specific original source passage with date and population/formulation.
Verify ES/EN/IT consistency and correct mismatches.
Implement and test evidence-backed decision rules, dose formulas, upper limits, interactions and safety exclusions.
Reaudit and enable release gates only after evidence/safety tests pass; no professional certification gate imposed.
